note: Second escrow, for agent settlement only. Deliberately separate from arc-testnet.json: that escrow holds live payments and is what the iOS app and the indexer point at, so this one adds the agent path without a cutover. The registry and yield adapter are shared, which is safe because policies are immutable and adapter shares are tracked per holder.

policyNote: Policy 10 names the deployed attestor, so a dispute against it is settled by a process nobody running the demo controls. Policy 9 is the earlier one; its attestor is anvil account #2, whose key is public, and setPolicyAttestor is one shot so it cannot be rotated. Payments 5 to 10 were settled against it inline.
